_readme: Machine-readable CLAIMED-SCOPE source for bin/check-mode-scope-warning, alongside (not instead of) the schema-description prose patterns. Shape: {"<actor-slug>": {"<field>": ["<mode>", ...]}}. A field listed here is treated as mode-scoped even if its input_schema.json description doesn't match any SCOPE_PATTERNS regex -- use this when a field IS restricted to certain modes but the description is worded in a way the prose patterns can't catch, so the check still requires a log.warning to name it. This is a sidecar file, not an input_schema.json key, because Apify's input-schema validator rejects unknown property keys outright (c2255 proved `x-appliesTo` fails `apify push` schema validation before any build step runs). Created cycle 2257; empty on purpose -- every mode-scoped field in the fleet today is already caught by prose (42 fields, 0 flags), so this exists for the NEXT field that isn't worded the regex's way, not a currently-known gap.
